results.title: JNIM and IS-linked fighting spreads to northwestern Nigeria | UA.NEWS
results.snippet:
In Nigeria, fighting between JNIM and groups linked to the Islamic State has spread to the country’s northwestern regions. As The Rio Times reports, clashes also took place in Burkina Faso, Mali, Niger and western Niger. Analyst Wassim Nasibia described the escalation as unprecedented in scale. results.title: ISSP claims over 400 JNIM fighters killed in Burkina Faso | UA.NEWS
results.snippet:
According to Nsaibia, from 2019 through September 2026, JNIM and ISSP fought more than 320 battles, resulting in approximately 2,200 deaths. The clashes, which had previously been largely limited to Mali and Burkina Faso, have in recent months spread to western Niger and northwestern Nigeria.
